name: Raselbot Integration
author: Raselbot

sections.description:
The Raselbot Integration plugin provides seamless connectivity between your WordPress site and the Raselbot automation platform. This powerful plugin enables you to automate various functionalities such as chat, notifications, and workflow management, enhancing the efficiency and engagement of your website.

Key Features:

  • Easy Connection: Effortlessly link your WordPress site with Raselbot, unlocking advanced automation tools.
  • Automated Chat Integration: Manage and automate chat interactions to provide instant support and engagement for your site visitors.
  • Workflow Automation: Streamline your site\’s operations by automating routine tasks, allowing you to focus on growth.
  • Custom Notifications: Keep your audience informed with automated notifications tailored to their needs and activities.
  • Simple Setup: User-friendly configuration ensures that even those with minimal technical expertise can set up the plugin quickly.
  • Chat Widget: Add a customizable chat widget to your site, allowing visitors to connect directly with your support team or receive automated responses.

This plugin is designed to bring the power of automation to your fingertips, making your WordPress site more responsive, efficient, and engaging.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/raselbot-integration directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the \’Plugins\’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Raselbot settings page to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
What is Raselbot?
Raselbot is an automation platform that simplifies business workflows, integrates chat features, and enhances customer communication.

How do I set up Raselbot Integration?
After activating the plugin:
1. Navigate to the Raselbot settings page under the WordPress dashboard.
2. Enter your Raselbot API credentials.
3. Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the setup.

Is Raselbot Integration plugin free?
Yes, the plugin is free to use. However, a Raselbot subscription may be required for advanced features.
